import collections
import django
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(DEBUG=True, DATABASES={}, INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.contenttypes', 'django.contrib.auth'])
django.setup()

from django.db.models.sql.query import Query
from django.db.models import F

q = Query(alias_cols=True)

plain_list = ['a', 'b']
plain_tuple = ('a', 'b')
NT = collections.namedtuple('NT', 'x y')
nt = NT('a', 'b')

r = q.resolve_lookup_value(plain_list, None, True, False)
print('list ->', type(r).__name__, r)
assert isinstance(r, list) and r == plain_list

r = q.resolve_lookup_value(plain_tuple, None, True, False)
print('tuple ->', type(r).__name__, r)
assert isinstance(r, tuple) and r == plain_tuple

r = q.resolve_lookup_value(nt, None, True, False)
print('namedtuple ->', type(r).__name__, r)
assert isinstance(r, NT) and r == nt

# expressions nested in lists still resolve, container type preserved
r = q.resolve_lookup_value([F('pk'), 'x'], None, True, False)
print('list with F ->', type(r).__name__, [type(v).__name__ for v in r])
assert isinstance(r, list) and hasattr(r[0], 'resolve_expression')

r = q.resolve_lookup_value((F('pk'), 'x'), None, True, False)
print('tuple with F ->', type(r).__name__, [type(v).__name__ for v in r])
assert isinstance(r, tuple) and hasattr(r[0], 'resolve_expression')

print('ALL EDGE CASES OK')

from django.db.models import F

plain_list = ['a', 'b']

NT = collections.namedtuple('NT', 'x y')
nt = NT('a', 'b')

r = q.resolve_lookup_value(plain_list, None, True, False)
print('list ->', type(r).__name__, r)
assert isinstance(r, list) and r == plain_list

r = q.resolve_lookup_value(plain_tuple, None, True, False)
print('tuple ->', type(r).__name__, r)
assert isinstance(r, tuple) and r == plain_tuple

r = q.resolve_lookup_value(nt, None, True, False)
print('namedtuple ->', type(r).__name__, r)
assert isinstance(r, NT) and r == nt

r = q.resolve_lookup_value([F('pk'), 'x'], None, True, False)
print('list with F ->', type(r).__name__, [type(v).__name__ for v in r])
assert isinstance(r, list) and hasattr(r[0], 'resolve_expression')

r = q.resolve_lookup_value((F('pk'), 'x'), None, True, False)
print('tuple with F ->', type(r).__name__, [type(v).__name__ for v in r])

# nested containers keep their types at each level
r = q.resolve_lookup_value([['a'], ('b',)], None, True, False)
